description: Preview your website inside realistic phone, tablet, laptop and monitor frames, right in VS Code: 71 devices, multi-device view, live reload and automatic dev server detection.
command.openFile: Device Frame Preview: Preview this HTML file
command.quickOpen: Device Frame Preview: Open (active file or server)
command.pickServer: Device Frame Preview: Choose a server…
config.defaultUrl: URL used when no dev server is detected (e.g. your Vite, Next or Django server).
config.defaultDevice: Device used the very first time (afterwards, the last selected device is remembered).
config.autoReload: Reload the preview when a file changes (HTML file mode). CSS changes are applied without reloading the page.
config.multiDevices: Devices shown side by side in multi-device mode (ids, e.g. iphone-se, pixel-8, ipad-mini, laptop-fhd, or user:<name> for a custom device).
config.customDevices: Custom devices added to the list.
config.showStatusBar: Show a “Preview” button in the status bar.
config.proxy: Route pages through a local proxy that removes X-Frame-Options and frame-ancestors, so sites that refuse to be embedded (Django, Rails…) can be previewed.
